subject: Novamed technical advocate connect — request for clinical integration reference
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Novamed reference need — late-stage medtech, on-prem EHR integration

Team —

Heads-up: Novamed (Series D medtech) is nearly across the finish line; procurement wants a 3rd-party technical reference focused on on-prem EHR integration and HL7/FHIR data flows. They are in the US (East Coast) and want something short — 20–30 min — with an engineer + clinical lead if possible.

Attached is their short MVP/interop checklist (novamed_MVP_requirements.xlsx). High priority: they want to hear from a customer who has done an on-prem connector and validated data lineage with SOC2 controls.

Can we surface an advocate who fits: US-based, has done EHR integrations (HL7/FHIR), comfortable on a recorded call, and can speak to performance at scale? If we can provide a short one-pager for the reference ahead of time, even better — I can handle outreach once we land a name.

Thanks — I need names by EOD so I can coordinate times with Novamed procurement.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0187

Attachment: novamed_MVP_requirements.xlsx (Excel, 78KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novamed reference need — late-stage medtech, on-prem EHR integration

Marissa —

Recommend Dr. Sameer Patel at PulseShift. They completed an on-prem FHIR adapter for Cerner earlier this year and ran a month-long validation with real clinical payloads; Sameer led the integration and is used to short, technical reference calls. He also signed an NDA for prior RFPs.

If useful, I have a one-paragraph blurb we can send to Sameer so he knows the ask and scope (interop, data lineage, SOC2 controls, perf numbers). I attached a quick profile I keep for reference outreach.

Availability note: Sameer is Central time; best windows are 11:00–15:00 CT weekdays.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood_ref_profile_pulseshift.pdf (PDF, 22KB)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-14T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novamed reference need — late-stage medtech, on-prem EHR integration

+1 on PulseShift. Also, flag for Monica: Novamed explicitly listed SOC2 and data retention questions in the RFI; they may want to dive into our audit logs and retention policies. Monica — can you be on standby to join the reference call in case the discussion goes deep into architecture/compliance?

We should offer to record the session (with consent) and deliver a 1-page redwood summary afterward — helps procurement and shortens cycles.

—Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
VP, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dr. Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@novamed.health>
Cc: Kyle Turner <kyle.turner@carebridge.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-11-14T15:18:00-05:00
Subject: Intro + proposed technical reference for Novamed (PulseShift)

Dr. Zhao —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per procurement's ask, we'd like to introduce a short technical reference who can speak to on-prem EHR connectors, FHIR/HL7 validation, and how data lineage/SOC2 controls were handled in a live pilot.

PulseShift (Dr. Sameer Patel) has agreed to a 30‑minute call to cover those topics. Proposed time slots (Eastern):
- Tuesday 11/16, 11:00–11:30 ET
- Tuesday 11/16, 14:00–14:30 ET
- Wednesday 11/17, 09:00–09:30 ET

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick intros (5 min)
2) PulseShift: architecture & integration checklist (10 min)
3) Q&A: data flows, audit logs, SOC2 controls (10 min)
4) Next steps for procurement (5 min)

Ben will attend to cover technical specifics. If you want an NDA signed before the call or a brief agenda note for your legal team, let me know — we can provide our standard mutual NDA or sign yours.

If any of these windows work, I’ll confirm and share a calendar invite / recording permission.

Best —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Attachment: novamed_MVP_requirements.xlsx (Excel, 78KB)
Calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

From: Dr. Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@novamed.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kyle Turner <kyle.turner@carebridge.ai>
Date: 2027-11-15T09:44:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed technical reference for Novamed (PulseShift)

Marissa —

Thanks — Tuesday 11/16 14:00–14:30 ET works for me and for procurement. Two quick asks before we connect:
1) Can you send a short agenda and the one‑paragraph blurb for the reference so procurement knows the scope?
2) Procurement requires a copy of any NDA or a vendor RFI; I’ve attached our RFI template for completeness.

We prefer to keep the call high level; procurement will have two people on the line. Recording is okay if the reference and PulseShift consent.

—Emily
Dr. Emily Zhao
Head of Clinical Integrations, Novamed Health Systems
emily.zhao@novamed.health
Attachment: Novamed_RFI_2027.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-11-16T16:35:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Novamed — PulseShift reference call 11/16 14:00 ET

All —

Confirmed for 11/16 at 14:00 ET with Dr. Zhao + procurement. I sent Sameer the blurb and asked him to confirm availability; Ben, please prep 3 bullets on: (1) HL7->FHIR mapping approach, (2) how we validated data lineage during pilot, (3) latency & throughput observations for 500 concurrent streams. Monica, please stand by for any SOC2/data-retention questions — procurement may ask for log retention windows and encryption-at-rest specifics.

I’ll share the calendar invite when Sameer confirms. We agreed to recording with consent.

—Marissa
